title: Island Workspace
description: A studio workspace with an account menu, a searchable project directory and a timeline that opens project details. The sidebar and raised panels share a responsive canvas.
summary: Studio dashboard with an account menu, project directory and activity timeline.
notes: The sidebar and workspace share a canvas. At narrower container widths the same links move above the content, and the four panels eventually stack in reading order. The workspace scrolls with the page.
Overview carries aria-current="page", which also draws its highlight. In an application, Projects and Activity link to their own pages; in the demonstration they jump to the matching panels.
The avatar opens an Actual CSS flyout with account links. Their URLs, including Sign out (usually a form POST), and each dialog's Open project link are placeholders the application supplies.
The brief, project details and directory use native dialog commands (show-modal and request-close), which need browser support for command and commandfor.

The project directory searches, sorts and filters the five sample records locally. Without JavaScript it displays the authored table, project details still open, and the account menu stays closed. Project data and profile details are read-only sample content.

When supplying your own project data, keep the overview, timeline, directory and the facts in each detail dialog aligned. In the chart, keep each label and --ab-island-count in sync and set --ab-island-chart-max to the top of the scale.
